steps.text: How healthy is your money? Tap Coach, then Reports.
Under Quarterly planning, tap Financial Health Score.
Your score is out of 100, with a letter grade, and your savings rate, debt, and monthly net.
Each part of the score shows what to work on, and Priority Actions lists what to do first.
Tap back. Under Monthly review, tap Merchant Analysis.
Everywhere your money goes, ranked by what you spend there. Pick a time frame, like 1M for this month.
